doctrine: Freeze the giant, train the small, verify everything, search aggressively, escalate model size only after data, retrieval and search saturate. No paid APIs, no cloud training. Acquisition is a one-time mirroring step; after it, the system runs disconnected.
nothing_acquired_yet: SUPERSEDED for D1–D4, D6, D7: those are generated locally from the pinned Mathlib (see ramanujan/data/corpora/GENERATION_RECEIPT.json). D5, D8, D9 remain PENDING and need a user licensing/selection decision. Acquisition of external corpora is still a licensing decision.

hard_rule_on_teacher_traces.rule: Do NOT generate teacher traces from the Math-Preserve artifact.
hard_rule_on_teacher_traces.why: It is semantically collapsed -- it predicts ' combust' for the capital of France and 'rus' for 2 + 2, confirmed by numpy oracle against the runtime. Traces distilled from it would teach a student to reproduce the collapse, and would look like data.
hard_rule_on_teacher_traces.enforced_by: odyssey/launch/SUBSTRATE_CAPABILITY.json marks the artifact REFUSED; any trace-generation path must consult it.
hard_rule_on_teacher_traces.what_to_use_instead: an artifact with capability_verdict APPROVED. None currently exists, so teacher-trace generation is blocked, and that is the correct state rather than a gap to route around.

required_per_source: license, read and quoted, not assumed
split assignment: train, eval, hidden, or fixture
contamination boundary against the evaluation sets
evidence status: what the data supports and what it does not

sources.name: Lean/Mathlib proof traces
sources.acquisition: derived locally from the pinned Mathlib once installed, not downloaded as a dataset
sources.license_question: Mathlib is Apache-2.0; derived traces inherit that and must carry attribution

sources.name: proof-state transitions
sources.purpose: best-first search policy and value training
sources.acquisition: generated locally from Mathlib by-blocks as source-level tactic sequences (structural transitions); scale-up can add info-tree instrumentation

sources.name: premise-selection pairs
sources.purpose: retrieval training: which lemmas matter for which goals
sources.acquisition: derived from Mathlib dependency structure locally

sources.name: compiler-error repair pairs
sources.purpose: repair training: broken proof plus the error plus the fix
sources.acquisition: generated locally by perturbing valid proofs and recording real compiler output
sources.note: this one needs no external data at all, only a working Lean. It is the cheapest real training signal available.

sources.name: informal/formal pairs
sources.license_question: OPEN. The obvious public corpora vary in terms and some are research-only. This needs a decision before anything is fetched.

sources.name: counterexample negatives
sources.acquisition: generated locally via Mathlib Counterexamples/ plus enumerative witnesses
sources.note: a system trained only on true statements learns to agree

sources.name: tool-use traces
sources.acquisition: generated locally from the search harness

sources.name: hidden rediscovery set
sources.purpose: Q2: can the system rediscover results it has never seen
sources.critical_constraint: must be selected and hash-committed BEFORE any training, and held out mechanically rather than by convention. The contamination barrier already built in tools/odyssey/ is the mechanism.

sources.name: frontier-variant set
sources.purpose: Q3: variants of open problems, to measure reach rather than recall

reusable_machinery_already_built.contamination_barrier: tools/odyssey/ -- indexes evaluation items from the sealed corpus, hidden items under commitment, and the public selection, then mechanically rejects overlapping training items, exact and near-duplicate. Verified by planting leaks it caught.
reusable_machinery_already_built.membership_checking: declared-vs-present, reporting DECLARED_NOT_PRESENT rather than treating a manifest entry as data
reusable_machinery_already_built.note: the Odyssey data lane's machinery applies unchanged here. It was built generically for exactly this reason.

acquisition_decisions_for_the_user: D5 informal/formal pairs: which corpus, under which licence
D8 hidden rediscovery set: which results to hold out, committed before training
D9 frontier-variant set: which open problems, and how variants are generated without leaking their answers
sequencing_note: D1, D2, D3, D4, D6 and D7 are all generated LOCALLY from a working Lean and Mathlib. They need no licensing decision and no external download. So the single highest-leverage unblock for Ramanujan data is installing the toolchain -- one bounded install unblocks six of nine sources.
